'''Marek Żukowski''' (born 11 December 1952) is a [[Polish people|Polish]] [[theoretical physicist]] and lecturer at the [[University of Gdańsk]]. He specializes in [[quantum mechanics]], his area of interest in particular concerns the [[Bell's theorem]] and quantum [[interferometry]].

==Life and career==
He was born on 11 December 1952, in [[Gdynia]], [[Polish People's Republic]]. He is a graduate of the Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry of the [[University of Gdańsk]]. After meeting [[Anton Zeilinger]], he developed an interest in [[information theory]] and quantum [[interferometry]]. Their first joint scientific paper was published in 1991, later they created a series of international projects called  ''Quantum Optics and Quantum Information''. Żukowski also collaborates with [[Harald Weinfurter]] from [[Munich]], [[Jian-Wei Pan]] from  [[Hefei]] and [[Mohamed Bourenanne]] from [[Stockholm]], as well as the [[National University of Singapore]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://ncn.gov.pl/o-ncn/rada-ncn/struktura-rady/marek-zukowski?language=en |title=prof. dr hab. Marek Żukowski |access-date=2018-08-06}}</ref> He is also involved in a number of European projects such as SCALA and Qubit Applications.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fnp.org.pl/en/prof-dr-hab-marek-zukowski-laureat-nagrody-fnp-2013/ |title=PROF. MAREK ŻUKOWSKI, PHD HAB. – FNP PRIZE 2013 LAUREATE |access-date=2018-08-06}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://iftia9.univ.gda.pl/~marek/ |title=HOME PAGE OF MAREK ZUKOWSKI, PROFESSOR OF PHYSICS |access-date=2018-08-06}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://en.ug.edu.pl/uniwersytet/o_nas/wybitni_i_utalentowani/41347/prof_marek_zukowski_-_interested_world_and_world_physics |title=Prof. Marek Żukowski – Interested in the World and the World is Physics |access-date=2018-08-06}}</ref>

He has been working at the University of Gdańsk since 1976. He was appointed head of the Department of [[Quantum Optics]] at the Institute of [[Theoretical Physics]] and [[Astrophysics]] in 1995, and was the Institute's director from 2005 to 2018. He has been a [[visiting professor]] at a number of universities abroad including the [[University of Innsbruck]], the [[University of Vienna]], [[Tsinghua University]] in [[Beijing]] and the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]]. Between 2010 and 2018, he was a member of the Council of the [[The National Science Centre (Poland)|National Science Centre]]. He is the 2013 laureate of the [[Prize of the Foundation for Polish Science]] in the mathematical, physical and engineering sciences, for his contributions into the research on multiphoton entangled states, which resulted in the formulation of [[information causality]] as a principle of physics.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fnp.org.pl/en/prof-dr-hab-marek-zukowski-laureat-nagrody-fnp-2013/ |title=PROF. MAREK ŻUKOWSKI, PHD HAB. – FNP PRIZE 2013 LAUREATE |access-date=2018-08-06}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=https://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=34199&_k=8mb6gp |title=prof. dr hab. Marek Żukowski |access-date=2018-08-06}}</ref>

== Private life ==
He is the son of graphic designer [[Halszka Żukowska]] and grandson of inventor, hydrotechnician and Member of the 1st Term Parliament of the [[Polish People's Republic]], professor [[Romuald Adam Cebertowicz|Romuald Cebertowicz]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Mikulski|first=Zdzisław|date=2005|title=Romuald Cebertowicz|url=http://sigma-not.net/download.php?token=x10deb7805835f7cfb5221291a57375c1|journal=Gospodarka Wodna|volume=3|pages=91|issn=0017-2448}}</ref>

==Awards==
*[[Johannes Hevelius]] Science Prize of the City of [[Gdańsk]] (2016)<ref>{{cite news|url=https://en.ug.edu.pl/media/aktualnosci/53462/city_gdansks_jan_heweliusz_award_scholarship_prof_marek_zukowski |title=The City of Gdańsk's Jan Heweliusz Award for Scholarship for Prof. Marek Żukowski |access-date=2018-08-06}}</ref>
*[[Copernicus Award]] (2014)<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.fnp.org.pl/en/copernicus-award-2014-conferred/ |title=The Polish-German Scientific Award COPERNICUS 2014 conferred |access-date=2018-08-06}}</ref>
*[[Prize of the Foundation for Polish Science]] (2013)
*[[Ministry of National Education (Poland)|Minister of National Education]] Prize (2007, 2000, 1994, 1983)

==Selected publications==
*''Event-Ready Deterctors Bell Experiment via Entanglement Swapping'' (Żukowski, Zeilinger, Horne, Ekert, Phys. Rev. Lett. 71, 4297, 1993
*''Violations of Local Realism by Two Entangled N-Dimensional Systems Are Stronger than for Two Qubits'' (Kaszlikowski, Gnaciński, Żukowski, Miklaszewski, Zeilinger, Phys. Rev. Lett. 85, 4418, 2000)
*''Bell’s Theorem for General N-Qubit State'' (Brukner, Żukowski, Phys. Rev. Lett. 88, 240401, 2002)
